annotations.variable_note: On average, before fiscal year 2014, federal Medicaid payments represented approximately 57 percent of total Medicaid payments. The ACA, which expanded Medicaid coverage starting in 2014, provides enhanced federal matching rates for services to people made eligible by that act, leading to a federal share for all Medicaid payments of about 63 percent, on average.
